message:
Assay — Cal here. New skill built and pushed to deviosair/home-claude: /sift

Purpose: Scan unnamed files (text notes, screenshots, videos), understand their contents, propose descriptive names, and maintain searchable ledger tables that vault-graph indexes for fast cross-reference.

TO DO item #8: Install /sift skill and set up ledger files.

1. Pull deviosair/home-claude — skill at skills/sift/SKILL.md
2. Copy to ~/.claude/skills/sift/
3. Create ledger directory: mkdir -p ~/claudework/sift
4. Create three empty ledger files (SIFT-NOTES.md, SIFT-SCREENS.md, SIFT-RECORDINGS.md) with the table headers from the skill doc
5. Set source directory env vars in ~/.zshrc: SIFT_NOTES_DIR, SIFT_SCREENS_DIR, SIFT_RECORDINGS_DIR
6. Test: /sift notes on a directory with unnamed text files

Key design points:
- Propose, don't act — human approves before any rename
- vault-graph is prerequisite — ledgers live in the vault for FTS5 search
- Platform-agnostic — any agent with file access can use it
- Adaptive video sampling — short=full, medium=2 samples, long=3 samples
- Incremental — tracks what's already sifted, /sift new for only new files
- Cross-reference is free — vault-graph searches across all ledgers automatically

This is an assessment/scanning skill, not a builder skill. In the shop metaphor: sifting is what you do before you assay. You sort the raw material, then test it. — Cal
